findings.message: Role/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-jaeger-operator adds rules that the current chart did not have.
Chart default `image.tag` changed from `1.49.0` to `1.61.0` and the rendered objects differ.

The pod template of Deployment/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-jaeger-operator changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=stageproof-rel-jaeger-operator].image. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.

findings.detail: Stageproof does not read that project's upgrade notes. A skip of more than one minor version, or a new major version, is named here and does not block.
findings.message: Chart version moves from 2.49.0 to 2.57.0, skipping 7 minor versions.

findings.detail: This is the chart's declared application version. It is not a test that the registry tag exists.
findings.message: appVersion moves from 1.49.0 to 1.61.0. The image that the chart runs may change with it.

findings.detail: The render names a different image, including images on custom resources and images passed as container arguments. Whether that tag exists is a separate check.
findings.message: 1 container image changed. Deployment/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-jaeger-operator.template.spec.containers[0] stageproof-rel-jaeger-operator container moves from jaegertracing/jaeger-operator:1.49.0 to jaegertracing/jaeger-operator:1.61.0.

findings.detail: A rehearsal installs the chart into an empty cluster. It does not upgrade data that is already there. An empty-cluster result of 0 restarts does not mean an existing workload stayed up.
findings.message: This chart ships custom resource definitions, and the application it runs is changing. Custom resources that already exist on a real cluster are not in this check.
Certificate/stageproof-check/jaeger-operator-service-cert was not judged. the API group is not installed on this server.
Issuer/stageproof-check/selfsigned-issuer was not judged. the API group is not installed on this server.
